Subject: Privacy & tracking follow-up: console telemetry, SOC 2, and vendor questionnaire

Hi Emma / MedX security team —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Per our conversation, I wanted to capture a short recap and the immediate next steps so we can keep the procurement track moving. High-level items you asked about:

- SOC 2 status: we are currently in the final phase of our Type II audit. Expected completion: mid-July 2026. In the meantime we can share a bridge letter and our current control matrices.
- GDPR / HIPAA: Redwood supports GDPR compliance; we offer a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for HIPAA-covered customers.
- Product telemetry / cookie tracking: you asked where telemetry originates (console agents vs. docs site), and whether customers can opt out of usage telemetry. The short answers: 1) we separate product telemetry (console + API metrics) from public docs/site analytics; 2) customers can configure telemetry collection for their private deployment (toggle in Console) and we provide an opt-out guide for hosted API usage logging in contracts.

Immediate next steps I have:
1) Please send over your vendor security questionnaire (VSA) — I see you dropped a note about a PDF during the call.
2) Rishi (cc) will propose a short technical deep-dive to go through data flows and telemetry knobs in the Console.
3) I will send our SOC 2 bridge letter and a high-level data flow diagram showing where telemetry is collected and what’s persisted.

Attachments I’m including: demo-recording.mp4 (short clip of the walk-through) and data-flow-diagram.png.

If you prefer, we can treat the VSA as an initial pass and then schedule a 45-minute session with Security + Engineering to go through specific control questions.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Hi Emma / MedX —

I’m Rishi, Security/SE on the account. Happy to run the technical Q&A and walk through the telemetry flows and retention settings. Quick answers to a few of your asks while we schedule time:

- BAA: Redwood will sign a standard BAA for hosted and private deployments; we can route legal for signature once we have procurement details.
- Retention defaults: console logs (operational telemetry) default to 90 days; API request metadata for hosted customers is retained 30 days by default and can be configured via customer settings or contractual SLAs. We can provide an export of the retention policy and a sample data retention config.
- Docs analytics: public docs (docs.redwood.com) use an aggregate analytics pipeline — no customer-identifiable tokens are written to analytics. We do not log API keys or customer IDs to public docs analytics.

If useful, I can share a short runbook and show the Console toggles (telemetry on/off, trace retention) in a screenshare. Proposed times for a 45-minute deep-dive:
- Wed 2026-05-20 16:00-16:45 UTC
- Thu 2026-05-21 14:00-14:45 UTC
- Fri 2026-05-21 19:00-19:45 UTC

Please reply with your preferred slot and I’ll send a calendar invite and a joint agenda.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
